description: Read one ERC-20 balance on Base.

address.description: EVM wallet address whose token balance should be read.

block.description: Optional block number or block tag such as latest.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key used to make a paid retry idempotent.

network.description: CAIP-2 network identifier; use eip155:8453 for Base mainnet or eip155:84532 for Base Sepolia.

token.description: ERC-20 contract address on the selected Base network.

name: get_erc20_balance

outputSchema.description: ERC-20 token balance in atomic units with optional token metadata.

title: get_erc20_balance
